step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard shows a data ingestion architecture for Riot Games' HONO over IP system. On the left, a player/user icon splits into two flows: one to an Amazon EKS cluster and another to an On-Premises Data Center (building icon). Both the EKS cluster and the OnPremDC feed into Amazon MSK (Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka). Data from MSK then streams into Amazon S3. AWS Glue is drawn as an isolated icon at the bottom right without direct connected arrows.
